note: Six synthetic demonstration scenarios. These are invented events, not logs from any real product, and every provider name is a placeholder. 'shows' and 'expected_behaviour' are narration for the operator; they are never sent to the model.

scenarios.title: 1. Known rate limit never reaches the model
scenarios.shows: A recognised 429 is decided by a deterministic rule, so no classification call is made and no tokens are spent.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: RETRY_LATER via rule R001, model_called = false, retry scheduled from the provider's Retry-After value.

event.error_message: Too many requests for this account. Retry after the indicated interval.

scenarios.title: 2. Unfamiliar consent wording reaches Jev
scenarios.shows: No rule matches this phrasing because it never says 'revoked'. The classifier reads the language and proposes reconnecting.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Model proposes REAUTHENTICATE and both uncertainty gates pass.

event.error_message: The application's consent was withdrawn. Establish a new grant before requesting records.

scenarios.title: 3. Authenticated but missing a read scope
scenarios.shows: A 403 that is genuinely a permission gap. There is deliberately no rule mapping 403 to permissions, so this is the classifier's judgement.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Model proposes FIX_PERMISSIONS; the simulated task names no grant it was not given.

event.error_message: Your application is authenticated but has not been approved for the read:contacts scope.

scenarios.title: 4. A deliberately vague access error
scenarios.shows: Nothing in this message distinguishes a bad credential from a missing entitlement. Whatever the model returns is displayed honestly, including an overconfident answer.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: Either an explicit ENGINEER_REVIEW selection or an uncertainty fallback. The event inspector labels which one occurred.

event.error_message: Access could not be completed at this time.

scenarios.title: 5. Exhausted retries override a retry
scenarios.shows: The same 429 as scenario 1, but the budget is gone. Policy escalates before rules and before any model call, so nothing can schedule another attempt.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: ENGINEER_REVIEW via policy P001, model_called = false.

event.error_message: Too many requests for this account. Retry after the indicated interval.

scenarios.title: 6. Expired cursor reaches resync assessment but not past approval
scenarios.shows: A resync assessment is created and stops at a human approval gate. Approval changes simulation state only; no resync is ever started.
scenarios.expected_behaviour: REVIEW_RESYNC via rule R020, workflow status PENDING_APPROVAL, requires_approval = true.

event.error_message: Saved replication offset predates the oldest retained log segment
